sn14.15:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate || || 2
sn14.15:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā pi kho Sāriputto sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ Bhagavato avidūre caṅkamati || || 3
sn14.15:1.3: Āyasmā pi kho Mahā-Moggallāno sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhim Bhagavato avidūre caṅkamati || || 4
sn14.15:1.4: Āyasmā pi kho Mahā-Kassapo sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhim Bhagavato avidūre caṅkamati || || 5
sn14.15:1.6: Āyāsmā pi kho Puṇṇo Mantāniputto sambahulehi || caṅkamati || 7
sn14.15:1.7: Āyasmā pi kho Upāli sambahulehi || || caṅkamati || || 8
sn14.15:1.8: Āyasmā pi kho Ānando sambahulehi || || caṅkamati || || 9
sn14.15:1.9: Devadatto pi kho sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ Bhagavato avidūre caṅkamati || || 10
sn14.15:2.2: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave Sāriputtaṃ sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantanti || ||
sn14.15:2.4: Sabbe kho ete bhikkhave bhikkhū mahāpaññā || || 11
sn14.15:2.5: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave Moggalānam sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantanti || ||
sn14.15:2.7: Sabbe pi kho ete bhikkhave bhikkhū mahiddhikā || || 12
sn14.15:2.8: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave Kassapam sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantanti || ||
sn14.15:2.10: Sabbe pi kho ete bhikkhave bhikkhū dhutavādā || || 13
sn14.15:2.11: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave Anuruddhaṃ sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantanti || ||
sn14.15:2.13: Sabbe pi kho ete bhikkhave bhikkhū dibbacakkhukā || || 14
sn14.15:2.14: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave Puṇṇaṃ Mantāniputtaṃ sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantanti || ||
sn14.15:2.16: Sabbe kho ete bhikkhave bhikkhū dhammakathikā || || 15
sn14.15:2.17: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave Upāliṃ sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantanti || ||
sn14.15:2.19: Sabbe kho ete bhikkhave bhikkhū vinayadharā || || 16
sn14.15:2.20: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave Ānandam sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantanti || ||
sn14.15:2.22: Sabbe kho ete bhikkhave bhikkhū bahussutā || || 17
sn14.15:2.23: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave Devadattaṃ sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ caṅkamantanti || ||
sn14.15:2.25: Sabbe kho ete bhikkhave bhikkhū pāpicchā || 18
sn14.15:3.4: Atītam pi bhikkhave addhānaṃ dhātuso va sattā saṃsandiṃsu samiṃsu || ||
sn14.15:4.1: Anāgatam pi bhikkhave addhānaṃ dhātuso va sattā saṃsandissanti samessanti || ||
sn14.15:5.1: Etarahi pi bhikkhave paccuppannam addhānaṃ dhātuso va sattā saṃsandanti samenti || ||
